name: Paneer
full_name: Paneer (Indian cottage cheese), plain, full fat
basis: Typical full-fat paneer from Indian pack labels and IFCT 2017: about 18 g protein and 21 g fat per 100 g.

name: Paneer bhurji
full_name: Paneer bhurji (scrambled paneer with onion and tomato), home style
basis: Per 100 g: about 70 g paneer, 25 g onion and tomato and 4 g oil; paneer values as for plain paneer.

name: Soya chunk curry
full_name: Soya chunk curry (soya badi in onion-tomato gravy), home style
basis: Per 100 g: about 25 g dry soya chunks (52 g protein and 345 kcal per 100 g dry on common pack labels), 25 g onion and tomato and 3 g oil.

name: Hung curd
full_name: Hung curd (thick, Greek-style curd), plain, low fat
basis: Typical plain low-fat Greek-style yogurt from pack labels: about 10 g protein and 73 kcal per 100 g.

name: Roasted chana
full_name: Roasted Bengal gram (bhuna chana), with skin
basis: Roasted Bengal gram, IFCT 2017 and common pack labels: about 22 g protein and 370 kcal per 100 g.
